about.title: Software engineer
about.subtitle: passionate about innovation
about.p1: I'm Jorge, 20 years old, from Cajamarca, Peru. I study Software Engineering at UPC and work as a Fullstack Developer at Arkabia, where I also lead the Meproind project technically.
about.p2: I work with React, Angular, Java, TypeScript, C# and Python. I design and model relational and non-relational databases, define architectures and coordinate teams under Scrum. I also automate processes with N8N and AI for real production clients.
about.p3: Self-taught by nature. I learn by building real things and always look for the cleanest, most scalable and maintainable solution.
about.motto: "The best way to predict the future is to invent it."

meproind-dev.description: Technical lead of the platform for a mining services company (a business idea from the Arkabia ecosystem), now in production. Multilingual React frontend (i18n) and a backend built entirely with N8N, with an IoT/industrial layer for monitoring and operational cost calculation.
highlights: Technical lead: architecture, business flows and system decisions
Multilingual React frontend (i18n: Spanish, English and Portuguese)
100% N8N backend: gravimetric table cost calculation
IoT/industrial layer: electricity, water usage and pricing per mineral
Database modeling and cloud deployment — in production
